copy_policy: Aggregate and evaluation manifest bytes preserved exactly; raw individual metrics and recommendation files excluded.

baselines.selection: Fixed formulas; no validation-fitted parameter or grid.

2026.claims: Exploratory reused validation evidence; no novelty, independent replication, causal, psychological or deployment claim.
2026.cohorts: Original seed-based user half for meta-fit selection; other half for development. Same previously inspected validation splits, exploratory reuse.
2026.control_interpretation: Adaptive versus fixed-flow jointly tests recurrent routing and fidelity changes. Hard-clamp fixes observed source states, so observed-only pooling also fixes upward routing and port states; only candidate downward queries can change. It does not isolate gates alone.
2026.effective_capacity: Equal allocated shapes do not mean equal active capacity: hard-clamp source-gate parameters are inactive; fixed-flow computes initial routes and gates only once.
2026.inference: All original TRAIN ratings supplied; TRAIN observations of every category excluded from ranking.
2026.initialization: Identical allocated parameter shapes and seed across variants; initialization hashes must match.
2026.labels: Only original TRAIN and validation pair IDs authorize rating parsing. No final TEST split is opened or its rating values parsed.
2026.ranking_scope: Liked and all-observed ranking are diagnostics with a different target; CE is not ranking accuracy.
2026.selection_direction: minimize; exact ties retain earliest checkpoint
2026.training_masks: Every epoch uses deterministic identity-only per-user masking with at least one context and one probe; identical across variants.
2026.training_reduction: mean probe CE per user, then mean across batch users
